_comment: Curated 🔥 overrides for lib/hotProducts.ts — ONLY for products we KNOW are exploding in interest right now but whose tracked star history is too short to show it mechanically (see lib/popularRanking.ts's trackedHot/youngRocket, which always win over entries here). Every entry MUST carry a concrete, checkable reason string; 'feels hot' is not a reason. Currently empty: everything we could defend (e.g. buzz's 32.5k stars on a ~6-month-old repo) already triggers mechanically, which is exactly how this file should trend.
